title: FILL BOND® ADVANCED AEROSPACE FILLER PUTTY – Fill Bond® Small Dual Cartridge
description: Specifically designed for exterior aviation application to fill rivets, seams and small spot-repair areas on fuselage, wings and empennage. Specially formulated to retain flexibility, Fill Bond® also has superior adherence to aluminum, steel and composite surfaces. High-film buildup is easily achieved while resisting cracking, chipping, splintering without sagging. Great spread ability for smooth application. Long, workable pot life increases efficiency. Sand in 2 - 6 hours for higher productivity. Cartridge packaging guarantees accurate mixing and dispensing every time with minimal waste.
